description: This Java source file defines MainPhoneActivity for an Android application that manages runtime permissions related to external storage and wearable device capabilities. It includes logic for establishing GoogleApiClient connections, sending and receiving messages with Wear OS devices, handling capability changes, and updating UI components based on permission status and communication results.

classes.name: MainPhoneActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing interactions between the phone and wearable device, including handling permissions, messaging, and UI updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up GoogleApiClient, and registers UI components.

methods.name: onClickWearBodySensors
methods.description: Triggers sending a data request to the wearable device.

methods.name: onClickPhoneStorage
methods.description: Handles permission check and displays storage info or initiates permission request.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from permission rationale activity.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Handles actions upon successful connection to GoogleApiClient, including capability checks and status updates.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Processes incoming messages from the wearable device.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends messages to connected wearable nodes.

methods.name: updateWearButtonOnUiThread
methods.description: Updates the UI button to reflect permission status.

methods.name: logToUi
methods.description: Logs messages to the UI thread safely.

methods.name: getPhoneStorageInformation
methods.description: Retrieves list of external storage files or status.

methods.name: sendWearPermissionResults
methods.description: Sends permission approval or denial status back to the wearable device.
